sections.text: A small studio that designs for the climate it works in, and leaves the building to those who do it best.

sections.heading: The people
sections.intro: Designers, all of them. The Studio claims no professional licence, and works with the engineers and contractors each client appoints.

sections.heading: Design services
sections.intro: We take on a small number of projects each year, across five services.

sections.heading: Start a conversation
sections.text: Eaves is a fictional studio, but the form works and a real person reads it.

seo.metaTitle: The Studio | Eaves, a fictional studio
seo.metaDescription: Eaves is a fictional Bangkok design studio, invented for a portfolio demo. This page presents its invented approach and people.
